source: practice labels (used while building, not held out)
confusion_note: Per-class cells for the 50 practice labels are not in this repository, so no practice confusion grid is drawn.

repro.note: sha256 recomputed from the committed output/dev.jsonl. Byte-identical reruns were recorded for that file. The engine was not re-run here; the event data is not in this checkout.

run_seconds_note: About 5–7 seconds per dev run, as recorded. Not re-timed here.
baseline_note: Name-only baseline on the practice labels. Not recomputed in this checkout.
dev_decisions_note: Recomputed by counting the decision field in output/dev.jsonl. These 819 hits have no practice label, so the split is not a score.

firedrill.label: a regression set we wrote, not an independent score
firedrill.note: Recomputed on this machine from demo-data/firedrill. Two runs, PYTHONHASHSEED 1 and 2, byte-identical. Expected answers were written from the policy text and were used while fixing the engine.
